connector.name: RepoFold
connector.registryDescription: A cited wiki of your GitHub repo: search, read pages, find symbols and ask, with line citations.
connector.summary: Hosted at repofold.dev over streamable HTTP. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace dev.repofold, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer <RepoFold API key>. Create a key at https://repofold.dev/account after connecting a repository.
